body:
## What it does

Everything goes through one command, which routes the question to the right kind of answer: a commercial problem, a content problem, or a what-should-I-do-now problem. When you name a trending topic it checks the topic is real before advising you to act on it. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Leechael shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
